content:
maya_cs: Heads up — Crescent AI QBR prep: massive embedding spend spike since onboarding, looks like 3x. Can we triage?
ethan_csm: Yep saw the alert. Spike began ~Mar 18. Embeddings primarily. @priya_finops can you grab a token vs embedding breakdown?
priya_finops: On it. Quick peek: nightly full reindex jobs plus a few ad-hoc large batch reruns.
priya_finops: sample lines: 
```
customer: crescent-ai, model: text-embedding-3-small, embedding_units: 12k/day -> 36k/day, started 2026-03-18
job: nightly-full-reindex @ 02:00 UTC, runs: 1/day
```
priya_finops: Likely cause: they rolled back incremental logic and run full reindexes as a safe fallback.
nora_engineer: We recommended incremental during onboarding. Their infra team applied a temporary full reindex script and never reverted. I pinged them earlier but no reply.
maya_cs: Immediate suggested steps: 1) Ask Crescent to pause nightly reindex, 2) Temporarily set an account-level embedding throttle to avoid runaway billing, 3) Prepare cost sims and offer commit/retainer or Dedicated pool options for QBR. Assign owners?
ethan_csm: I'll message the customer and request pause now. I'll cc Maya.
priya_finops: I'll run three sims: no commit, 3-month commit, 12-month commit and show savings + breakeven. Need last 30d CSV — @billing-bot can you attach?
billing-bot: Uploaded CSV: https://redwood.prod/storage/csvs/1747352468-crescent-costs.csv :receipt:
maya_cs: Also capture this as "onboarding friction" in QBR notes — they resorted to full reindex because incremental tooling felt brittle. Add to feedback list.
nora_engineer: I'll draft a one-page incremental reindex guide and include a minimal code snippet the infra team can drop into their pipeline. Will target EOD tomorrow.
nora_engineer: snippet: 
```
# incremental reindex pattern (pseudo)
cursor = last_synced_id
while True:
  updates = fetch_updates(cursor, limit=500)
  if not updates: break
  embeddings = compute_embeddings(updates)
  upsert_embeddings(embeddings)
  cursor = updates[-1].id
```
ethan_csm: Sent pause request, awaiting confirmation. I'll escalate if no reply in 2h.
priya_finops: Filing sims now. Will include recommended guardrails: suggest account-level throttle at 20k/day until steady state confirmed.
maya_cs: QBR scheduled 2026-03-28 11:00 PT. Add cost slides, commit sims, onboarding friction bullets, and the incremental guide as an appendix. Dry run tomorrow — I'll share slides by EOD today.
ethan_csm: Thanks — I'll follow up on customer side and capture their feedback during the pause ask.
priya_finops: Deliverables: cost sims by Fri EOD, throttle recommendation in console, pricing options (commit vs Dedicated).
nora_engineer: Deliver incremental guide by tomorrow noon.
maya_cs: Great work team, logging this thread into the QBR folder and tagging for dry run. :thumbsup:
